# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

I am committed to keeping gostatus secure.
At this time, I only provide security updates and patches for the latest stable version.

If you are using an outdated version, I strongly recommend upgrading to the most recent release to ensure you have the latest security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

If you discover a potential security flaw in gostatus (e.g., sensitive data leakage, improper payload handling, or crashing vulnerabilities), please report it via one of the following methods:

1. **GitHub Security Advisory:** Navigate to the [Security tab](https://github.com/vmphase/gostatus/security/advisories/new) of this repository and select "Report a vulnerability". This is the preferred method as it allows for a private discussion, collaborative fixing, and a formal CVE assignment if necessary.
2. **Email:** You may contact the lead maintainer directly at [vmphase.dev@gmail.com](mailto:vmphase.dev@gmail.com).

### My Response Process

Once a report is received:

- I will acknowledge the report within **48 hours**.
- I will work on a fix in a private, secure environment.
- A security advisory and a patched version will be published simultaneously to notify the community.

## Disclosure Policy

I ask that you do not disclose the vulnerability publicly until a fix has been released.
This helps protect users who rely on gostatus.
